lede: Choose a text colour and a background colour to see the contrast ratio, pass or fail for WCAG AA and AAA, and a live readable preview.

faq.a: Normal text needs 4.5:1 for AA and 7:1 for AAA. Large text (about 18.66 px bold or 24 px regular) needs 3:1 for AA and 4.5:1 for AAA.

faq.q: Why is contrast important for thumbnails and captions?
faq.a: Many viewers watch on phones in daylight. Text that just passes on a desktop screen can disappear outdoors, so a comfortable margin above the minimum matters.
The colour pickers are the simplest route, but you can also type a hex value such as #1d4ed8 in the field next to each swatch.
